mitigations.awareness: Publish plain-language information about routes, operating hours, benefits, risks and complaint procedures, and hold accessible public question sessions.
mitigations.institutional_trust: Publish independent oversight reports, incident disclosures and responses to resident complaints, with a named accountable operator.
mitigations.training: Offer free, accessible resident training with practical demonstrations and alternative formats.
mitigations.participation_skills: Provide accessible instruction and assisted channels for residents to report problems and participate in decisions.
mitigations.personal_privacy: Use privacy masking of residential windows and yards, minimise collection of identifiable imagery, restrict retention and access, and independently audit these controls. Navigation still needs to operate safely; these controls do not guarantee zero intrusion.
mitigations.perceived_safety: Review routes to reduce exposure of people on the ground, assess emergency landing arrangements, and publish independent safety assessments and incident procedures. Residual risk remains.
mitigations.system_reliability: Require independently reviewed reliability testing, failure-response procedures, maintenance checks and a monitored pilot before expansion. Failures cannot be ruled out.
mitigations.data_security: Minimise retained data, encrypt stored and transmitted data, restrict access, specify deletion periods and commission independent security audits. No system is guaranteed immune to attack.
mitigations.acoustic_impact: Introduce agreed quiet periods for routine flights, define emergency exceptions, and test quieter equipment or alternative routing using measurements at affected homes before expansion. Actual sound reduction would need verification.
mitigations.aesthetic_clutter: Trial alternative corridors and lower flight frequency to reduce visible aircraft in affected views, and consult residents on the trial results. Aircraft may remain visible.
mitigations.visible_physical_intrusion: Trial corridors farther from residential properties and review flight frequency with affected residents. Aircraft may remain visible.
mitigations.rotor_wind: Site take-off and landing areas away from pedestrians and vulnerable structures, with tested separation distances and barriers where appropriate.
mitigations.airspace_traffic: Coordinate drone operations with other airspace users, set traffic limits and separation procedures, and review capacity before expansion.
mitigations.urban_mobility_plan: Include the service in the city mobility plan through public consultation, with published objectives, alternatives and review criteria.
mitigations.facility_siting: Compare alternative facility locations through public consultation and assess impacts on nearby residents before selecting a site.
mitigations.land_allocation: Publish proposed land allocations and alternatives, protect essential public uses, and consult affected communities before approval.
mitigations.energy_demand: Publish an energy budget, compare demand with existing transport options and limit expansion unless agreed energy targets are met.
mitigations.emissions: Commission a lifecycle emissions comparison with existing delivery options and make expansion conditional on agreed emissions targets.
mitigations.cost_financing: Publish costs and funding sources, compare financing alternatives, and set explicit limits on public spending and resident charges before approval.
mitigations.business_viability: Run a limited pilot with independently reviewed operating costs, demand and funding commitments, and publish criteria for continuation.
mitigations.remote_access: Include remote communities in service planning and publish coverage and delivery commitments alongside existing delivery alternatives.
mitigations.vulnerable_access: Design access with vulnerable groups, provide assisted options and assess whether service arrangements introduce new barriers.
mitigations.transport_connections: Coordinate drone deliveries with hospital, ambulance and ground transport workflows, with explicit handover and backup procedures.
mitigations.congestion: Pilot the service and measure effects on road traffic and ground deliveries before claiming congestion benefits.
mitigations.medical_public_benefit: Evaluate clinical usefulness with healthcare providers, compare delivery alternatives and publish pilot outcomes before expansion.
mitigations.distributive_equity: Publish how benefits and burdens are distributed across neighbourhoods and groups, consult affected communities and revise unequal allocations.
